title: DECISION: INBOX rights lockdown by construction in MailboxRights
description: inbox_defaults() hardcodes may_add_items: false, may_remove_items: false, may_rename: false, may_delete: false. The Sent folder adds may_add_items: true and may_submit: true to support copy-on-send. Each special folder role has its own named constructor that encodes the semantic constraints of that role. Alternative rejected: a single generic 'user-owned' rights set applied to all special folders. That would be permissive by default and require callers to remember to restrict the INBOX, which is an error-prone pattern. Alternative rejected: storing rights in the database. Rights for special folders are policy, not data — they are stable, derived from the role name, and do not vary per user. Encoding them as code makes them auditable and prevents privilege escalation via a DB write.
